review_type: Independent adversarial question-coverage review; not a summary correctness audit
scope: Only the complete 188-line 2014 core extraction and four named coverage artifacts. Novelty assessed against accepted questions 1–42, without answer material.
verdict_rationale: One explicit setup procedure is untested: shuffle noble tiles before revealing the active set. Existing questions request noble counts and unused-tile removal; Q3 requests shuffling only development decks. Always selecting favored nobles can satisfy every accepted question while omitting this source instruction. This is a distinct random-selection procedure, not a count swap or mechanical combination.

genuinely_novel_candidates.question: During setup, may the organizer choose which noble tiles will be revealed, or what procedure must be used to select the active noble tiles?
genuinely_novel_candidates.novel_source_fact: Shuffle the noble tiles before revealing the active set.
genuinely_novel_candidates.novelty_rationale: Q1, Q2 and Q35 constrain how many noble tiles are active or unused, not how they are selected. Q3 explicitly asks about development decks, not nobles. A mistaken chosen-nobles procedure survives all those questions. The source states an untested randomization operation.
genuinely_novel_candidates.ledger_correction: R07 groups noble shuffling with counts/removal and cites Q3, but Q3 never asks noble selection/shuffling. R07 is only partially exercised.
genuinely_novel_candidates.qualification: Uncovered explicit procedural fact; no interaction is required to establish novelty.
